newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Death squad kills five in Colombian resort city.
newsitem.headline: Death squad kills five in Colombian resort city.

text.p: Hooded gunmen killed three men and two women early Thursday in a raid on a working-class neighbourhood on the outskirts of Cartagena, Colombia's prime tourist resort, police said.

They said the gunmen were believed to belong to a vigilante group or death squad known as "The Hoods" that has killed at least 30 people in poor neighbourhoods in and around the historic port city since late 1995.
Most of the victims turned out to have had police records for common crimes. Local human rights groups suspect the authorities of tacitly supporting or giving final go-aheads for selective killings.
